授業概要
日本教育行政学会年報を手掛かりに、教育行政学の出発地を確認し、その問題意識を継承・発展させるための今後の方向性と社会的役割を考察する。
Using the Annual Review of the Japan Educational Administration Society as a point of departure, this course revisits the origins of educational administration as a field and examines its future directions and social role by building on and further developing its foundational concerns.
